q: What types of businesses does Central Insurance Agency insure?
a: Central Insurance Agency (CIA) specializes in commercial insurance for high-risk and highly regulated industries: security guard companies, alarm and security system installers, fire suppression contractors, general contractors and specialty trade contractors, janitorial and cleaning companies, home healthcare agencies, and private investigators.

q: Does Central Insurance Agency work with businesses outside New York?
a: Yes. CIA is headquartered in Smithtown, New York, and works as a nationwide commercial insurance broker. In California it does business under license #OH16068 as CIA West Insurance Services.

q: What commercial insurance coverages does CIA offer?
a: CIA places general liability, workers' compensation, professional liability, excess and umbrella, commercial auto, employment practices liability (EPLI) and bonding, as well as employee benefits including group health, voluntary benefits and union benefit programs.

q: What is a line-by-line insurance policy review?
a: In a line-by-line review, the CIA team examines each provision of your commercial policy, including its terms, conditions, exclusions and limitations, to find gaps, ambiguities and possible savings, and checks the coverage against your operations, contracts and industry requirements. Reviews are best done well before renewal.

q: Can CIA help with a workers' compensation or general liability audit?
a: Yes. CIA's insurance audit counseling advises on operations and insurance strategies that can reduce the risk of an unfavorable general liability or workers' compensation audit, and helps you understand your options if an audit has already gone against you.

q: How do I get a quote from Central Insurance Agency?
a: Call 877-242-9600, email contactus@ciainsures.com, or use the request form on the Contact page. A CIA specialist will review your operations and current coverage before recommending a program.
